name: cast-blueprint
description: CAST Blueprint: turn CAST Imaging analysis + AI into customer-consumable outputs organized by four focus areas (migration & modernization, tech debt & risk reduction, application management, process & application reimagination): spec, business rules, user stories, diagrams, technical debt, to-be design, target state, running costs, modernization/remediation plan, ROI and an 'Ask this Blueprint' chat, all with an evidence trail. One orchestrator skill plus one skill per section.
